title: Toys and Games
text:
Tom has many toys. He has a red ball, a small car, and a big teddy bear. He likes to play with the ball in the park. His favorite toy is the teddy bear because it is soft.

Anna likes games. She plays a board game with her sister on Sunday. They play with cards and small pieces. Anna always wins because she is very good at games. Her sister says it is not fair, but they both laugh.

questions.text: What game does Anna play with her sister?
How does Tom probably feel when he plays with his ball in the park?
Why does Anna's sister say it is not fair?
options: They play outside in the park

vocabulary.definition: a game played on a table with a board and pieces
is first or best in a game

paragraph_translations: Tom ma dużo zabawek. Ma czerwoną piłkę, mały samochód i dużego pluszowego misia. Lubi bawić się piłką w parku. Jego ulubiona zabawka to miś, bo jest miękki.

Anna lubi gry. W niedzielę gra w grę planszową ze swoją siostrą. Grają w karty i małe pionki. Anna zawsze wygrywa, bo jest bardzo dobra w grach. Jej siostra mówi, że to nie jest fair, ale oboje się śmieją.
